entities.summary: Valon Saraçini is a Macedonian politician of Albanian descent. He served as the Minister of Economy of Macedonia, today known as North Macedonia. He took the office of a Minister of Economy in July 2011, setting as priorities in his mandate the improvement of the business climate, increasing competitiveness of Macedonian economy, development of an efficient and stable energy system, planned and sustainable utilization of mineral resources and development of tourism.
